LESSON: ULUM AL- HADITH

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Ulum al- Hadith

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Ulum al- Hadith. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What role did the Prophet (S.A.W.) play in the development of Hadith?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs
2. explain the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
3. apply the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
4. value Hadith as a primary source of guidance
5. explain the relevance of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in the life of a Muslim
6. practise the teachings of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in daily life
7. appreciate Hadith as the second source of sharia

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ULUM AL- HADITH
This lesson teaches Ulum al- Hadith for Grade 8 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. explain the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. apply the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. value Hadith as a primary source of guidance
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
5. explain the relevance of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in the life of a Muslim
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
6. practise the teachings of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in daily life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
7. appreciate Hadith as the second source of sharia
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Ulum al- Hadith using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Ulum al- Hadith above.
2. Explain Ulum al- Hadith to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Ulum al- Hadith.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Ulum al- Hadith with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Ulum al- Hadith important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What role did the Prophet (S.A.W.) play in the development of Hadith?
2. Why is it important for a Muslim to learn Ulum al- Hadith?
3. Why is intention important in Islam?
4. Why should Muslims respect authority?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs
2. explain the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
3. apply the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
4. value Hadith as a primary source of guidance

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
